model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” (y-axis, ranging from 0 to 30 with major ticks at intervals of 10) of six different language model configurations—mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across nine language families or categories listed along the x-axis: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. Each category displays a group of six vertically oriented bars, color-coded according to the legend in the upper right: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, light pink for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. Error bars extend vertically from each bar, indicating variability or uncertainty in the effect measurement. The height of each bar reflects the magnitude of the effect for that model-language pair; for example, in the IE-Indic group, XLM-B₂ (red) reaches approximately 21, while mBERT-L₂ (light blue) is near 0. In contrast, for the Isolate group, all models show very low effects, mostly below 2. The Semitic group shows a notable peak for XLM-B₂ (red, ~20), while mBERT-R₂ (light green) is near zero. The Uralic group has uniformly low effects across all models, mostly under 2. No consistent ordering of bar heights is observed across categories, and the bars are not sorted by value within each group.
